issue.body:
We are seeing some CI failures in quarkus native integration tests on the master branch (22.3.0-dev tree). This serves as a tracker for all issues in prep for the 22.3.0 release:

# Mandrel only (not seen with GraalVM CE):

https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/27211 (Fixed with https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/27225)

# GraalVM CE and Mandrel:

https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/27232 (Fixed with https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/27366)
https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/27300 (Fixed with https://github.com/oracle/graal/pull/4997)
https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/27791 (Fixed with https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/27960)

issue.title: Add osgi-core dependency for liquibase-core

labels.name: area/dependencies
labels.description: Pull requests that update a dependency file

issue.body:
liquibase-core (optionally) depends on osgi-core for API classes that
the GraalVM CE native image generator detects.
Class.getDeclaredClass0() fails on some liquibase methods.  In
particular liquibase.Scope.getCurrentScope().

Add the dependency to the classpath so that it's available at image
generation time where everything is initialized at build time.

Closes #27232

body:
Relevant code in Liquibase core looks like this:

```
rootScope.values.put(Attr.osgiPlatform.name(), Activator.OSGIContainerChecker.isOsgiPlatform());
```

That triggers loading of the `Activator` [class](https://github.com/liquibase/liquibase/blob/v4.15.0/liquibase-core/src/main/java/liquibase/osgi/Activator.java#L15) which implements `BundleActivator` et.al.

issue.title: Resteasy Reactive: Add JAXB API as runtime dependency
issue.body:
The Link java class from JAXRS API contains a JAXB Adapter that inherits of XmlAdapter (from JAXB API). 

The Mandrel native build detects the missing dependency and fails with:

